title: No cooling output from rooftop AHU-1
description: Operator reports the rooftop air handler is running but supply air is no longer cold. Suspect refrigerant loss.

title: UPS-03 battery self-test warning
description: UPS-03 front panel is displaying a recurring battery self-test failure warning light.

title: Minor oil residue near compressor base
description: Facilities staff noticed a small oil stain forming on the floor beneath COMP-12. No performance impact observed yet.

title: Spindle vibration exceeds tolerance on CNC-02
description: Vibration readings on the main spindle have crept above the acceptable threshold during high-speed cuts.

title: Pump-04 seal leak reported by operator
description: A slow drip has been observed at the mechanical seal housing of the chilled water circulation pump.

title: Lift-01 door sensor intermittent fault
description: The freight elevator's door safety sensor occasionally fails to register an obstruction, delaying door closure.

title: AHU-1 compressor short-cycling
description: The rooftop unit's compressor is starting and stopping in rapid succession, risking premature failure.

title: Replace aging UPS-03 battery modules
description: Battery modules are past their rated service life and scheduled for proactive replacement.

title: Scheduled quarterly filter change for COMP-12
description: Routine preventive maintenance to replace intake air filters on the rotary screw compressor.

title: Replacing worn ball screw on CNC-02 X-axis
description: Positioning accuracy on the X-axis has degraded; the ball screw assembly is being replaced.

title: Pump-04 bearing failure causing excessive noise
description: A failing bearing is producing loud grinding noise and elevated vibration on the circulation pump.

title: Recalibrating LIFT-01 load sensor
description: Load sensor readings drift out of calibration and are being recalibrated against reference weights.

title: Replaced air filters on AHU-1
description: Routine filter replacement completed on the rooftop air handler as part of preventive maintenance.

title: Resolved UPS-03 firmware fault causing false alarms
description: A firmware update was applied to UPS-03 to fix recurring false low-battery alarm notifications.

title: Duplicate report of COMP-12 pressure fluctuation
description: Ticket was filed in error, duplicating an already-resolved pressure fluctuation report. Closed with no work performed.
